messages:
alex: Quick question — we need to tighten staging SIEM retention and clarify who can unmask logs for investigations. Proposal: 90d default for staging exports, 365d for prod exports, and a JIT unmask flow with RBAC and KMS gating. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on shorter staging retention. any compliance constraints from legal?

samir: Legal said nothing hard-blocking for staging, just need audit trail for who accessed. Prod 365 sounds fine if we keep strict key control.

lina: For unmasking, we should avoid full plaintext exports. Prefer ephemeral, scoped views that decrypt server-side and stream to authorized session only.

alex: Agree. High-level components:
- retention policy config in SIEM export job
- KMS envelope keys per environment
- RBAC role: security_readonly, security_investigator (JIT elevate)
- audit event created for every unmask attempt

samir: Quick draft for JIT workflow:
1) Analyst opens ticket with case id
2) security-oncall approves via Slack workflow or PagerDuty
3) eng-infra-bot issues short-lived access token (TTL 4h) tied to key policy
4) token used to create ephemeral query session that only returns masked->unmasked fields for that query

maria: nice. add requirement: every unmask session logs full query and result hashes into audit index (no plaintext stored).

alex: Example retention config we can push to exporter: 
```
{
  "env": "staging",
  "export_retention_days": 90,
  "export_destination": "siem-primary",
  "kms_key_alias": "alias/redwood-logs-staging",
  "masking_policy": "standard-pii-v2"
}
```

samir: KMS notes: use envelope encryption so SIEM only stores ciphertext; key usage goes through KMS proxy that checks role and JIT token. Rotate keys quarterly. Also we should add a separate wrapping key for prod vs staging.

lina: Masking policy v2 should include: email -> hashed, ip -> /24 truncation, user_id -> salted hash, free_text -> redact detected credit-card patterns. Keep masking rules in repo as code.

security-oncall: Small operational ask: ensure oncall also gets an email and slack notif when unmasking is approved. We need kops for post-incident traceability.

alex: Agreed. Action items: 
- samir: prototype JIT token + KMS proxy (due EOW)
- lina: open PR for masking_policy v2 and add unit tests (due Tue)
- maria: verify legal audit requirements and sign off on 90d staging retention (due Thu)
- security-oncall: update playbook with notification step (ASAP)

samir: I'll start a branch and push minimal KMS proxy with test harness. Will wire eng-infra-bot to mint tokens after approval.

maria: I'll confirm with legal and post back here.

lina: PR coming in ~2h.

alex: Thanks all. if no blockers I'll file a RFC doc and schedule a 30m sync after the PR lands.

eng-infra-bot: NOTE: New draft RFC created: rfc/siem-retention-jit-unmasking (link: https://r.redwood/infra/rfc/1234)

alex: leaving this open for comments, tagging samir and lina to follow up on the implementation details. :white_check_mark:
